results.content:
A survey from YouGov/Economist released on Tuesday shows that in a generic congressional vote, 36 percent of U.S. adults would pick the Democratic candidate compared to 31 percent who would pick the Republican candidate. One percent said other, eight percent said not sure and 23 percent said they would not vote.

The poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adults from August 28-31 and had a margin of error of 3.5 percent. [...] A Quantus Insights poll shows that among 1,200 likely voters, 49.7 percent would pick Democrats in the generic congressional ballot compared to 42.8 percent for Republicans and 7.5 percent were undecided.
